PlatformExtensionRegisterRequest.description: Publish/stage an immutable package record. Capability approval and active installation require extension.install; registration cannot grant access.

PlatformExtensionEditRequest.description: At least one patch field required; validate configuration_json against pinned manifest config_schema. Status transitions cannot expand grants; every write requires expected-version metadata.

PlatformExtensionInstallRequest.description: Install exactly the approved immutable package/capability plan; reject moved tags, stale plan/policy and unapproved grant expansion.

PlatformExtensionRevokeRequest.description: Revoke leases and broker access before best-effort runtime cancellation. Always cancel future delivery dispatch.

PlatformReplayRequest.description: Replay references the selected delivery path ID; create a new delivery ID/original reference, keep event ID unchanged, reauthorize current grant and retained projection.

PlatformEventSubscribeRequest.description: Extension mode requires same-tenant active installation and registered handler; webhook mode requires same-tenant ForgeWebhook ID. Select exactly one target; a URL alone cannot create an unapproved destination.

PlatformAuditExportRequest.description: Export authorized audit projection to protected storage. Output reference access reauthorizes and observes expiry/retention; do not include raw bearer tokens, secret values or signing keys.

PlatformFleetConfigureRequest.description: Nonempty patch. Validate tested image/class registry, max concurrency within tenant/account quota, minWarm<=maxConcurrency. Drain stops admission; existing jobs finish or are cancelled by explicit operation. USD budget in cents; no claimed billing rate.

PlatformConformanceReport.description: Coverage is measured, never implied by schema presence. Source-proven enterprise-host agent-task restriction keeps full_unmodified_gh_parity false while unresolved.

PlatformOperationCancelRequest.description: Idempotent cancellation intent; completion may win. Does not roll back committed side effects. Idempotency key and expected-version are shared mutation metadata, not duplicated here.
